default.description: Claude Code writes a turnAttributionKey on the launch-prompt line of every transcript; its value is a UUID (a turn id, not a credential). gitleaks' generic-api-key matches it on the key name, so without this exception the store refuses every real transcript (docs/units/RETRO-API/audit.md A11). Only that key with a UUID-shaped value is excepted; the same value under any other key is still refused.

description: Exceptions the retro store's secret scan adds on top of the repo's own gitleaks config (local-checks.gitleaks_config, unchanged): each regex is matched against a finding's match text (gitleaks regexTarget match). The repo-wide scan does not read this.
